name: playwright
description: Browser automation powered by the official Microsoft Playwright MCP server — navigate, click, type, fill forms, scrape, mock network, and inspect accessibility trees in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Chrome, or Edge.

interface.shortDescription: Drive any browser with the Microsoft Playwright MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can control a real browser — navigating sites, clicking buttons, filling forms, scraping content, and taking screenshots. Powered by Microsoft's Playwright, it works across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. Use it for automated web testing, scraping data from sites that don't have APIs, filling out online forms, or any task that needs a real browser. Your agent sees the page through its accessibility tree, making interactions precise and reliable.
defaultPrompt: Go to this URL and summarize what's on the page.
Fill out this form and submit it for me.
Scrape the data from this page and organize it.
